'''''Hutt's Ambition''''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It served in the [[Bothan Combat Response Element]] and fought in the [[Battle of Kathol System]], in which it assisted in the defeat of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].<ref name="END" />
